scope: Offline adapter and runtime verification only. No provider requests were made by these validation scripts; the separately completed paid pilot supplied one frozen code artifact and its training tapes for profiling.

assertions: Final candidate/seed feedback is re-evaluated from its actual code
Public population JSON omits test fields and large matrices
Complete candidate/checkpoint feedback remains in compressed audit files
mock_full_vs_compact.evaluation_count_note: Compact mode requires separate final full-feedback calls; this changes evaluation accounting, not the optimizer objective or method.

resume_checks.provider_request_replay: Synthetic exact-metadata matching request, response and complete ledger were replayed without calling the mock client.
resume_checks.unresolved_request: Synthetic pending provider ledger blocked replay and re-POST.
resume_checks.exclusive_chain_lock: A held chain lock prevented a second runner from entering.

compiler_checks: Changing OPT_PARAM numeric values retained structure SHA and reused one compilation.
Original and compiled actions agreed on the checked public states.
A multi-window result used one simulation and returned per-path metrics including order units.
Multiple assignments on an OPT_PARAM source line were rejected.

frozen_pilot_training_profile.parity: avg, lower, upper and all 50 per-path total costs compared with exact equality; compact intermediate cost_matrix/order_matrix are empty.
frozen_pilot_training_profile.timing_limit: One frozen policy on one machine; this is an execution overhead measurement, not a new performance-selection trial or an across-policy runtime guarantee.

memory_measurements.units_note: macOS resource.ru_maxrss divided by 1024^2; ps rss is KiB. These are short-run measurements, not a measured 100-candidate peak.

provenance_note: Results transcribed from assertions and timing outputs of the local validation scripts executed in this task. Temporary mock fixture directories were removed. The final model-recovery guard was added and separately tested after the compact timing checks; the source hashes identify the final frozen files.
